reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges
reddit.body: We're excited to share a new feature in Provincia that enhances your building experience! Instead of a single cost chip for each tile, you can now see a detailed materials list that shows you exactly what you have stored versus what you need. This means no more guessing if you have enough resources for your next construction project. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
